findings.passage: "People are sitting quietly in their rooms; they are trying to scheme and devise laws that will further restrict our rights to vote, and that happened in this past legislative session," Ford told those gathered at the Owens Health and Wellness Center at Tougaloo College on Saturday. "Bills were filed to try to strip and purge the voter roll, just because people have not participated in a series of elections, and that we cannot stand for."
findings.note: Speaking at a voting-rights event at Tougaloo College, as quoted by the Jackson Free Press, she objects to 2021 bills that would remove people from the voter roll for not voting in a series of elections. Not about ID or citizenship directly.
